resources.string: Browsers you pair with the CometOTP extension show up here.
Syncing is paused because CometOTP has no lock. Set one up in Security to keep your browsers up to date.
Being removed: waiting for the relay
Lost its connection: pair it again
Not updated while CometOTP has no lock
It stops getting your services from this phone and deletes its copy the next time it checks. A computer that is lost, stolen or offline keeps what it already has.
Removed here. The relay will be told when CometOTP can reach it.
If that computer was lost or stolen, turn two-factor authentication off and on again for these services, so that its copy stops working.

resources.string: Point your camera at the QR code in the CometOTP extension
That QR code is not from the CometOTP extension. Try another.
That code needs a newer version of CometOTP. Update the app, then try again.
That code pairs a browser. Use Pair a browser in Security → Connected extensions.

CometOTP reads the QR code here on your phone. No picture of it is saved. The code only lets this phone and the browser find each other through the relay: none of your services are shared until you tap Pair.
